claims.name: Anurag Rao
claims.title: Level Set Method for Mean Curvature
claims.description: We will apply the Level Set method developed by Sethian and Osher to problems of Mean Curvature.

claims.name: Zhiwei Gao
claims.title: Asymptotic Analysis of Rare Events in Stochastic Partial Differential Equations via the Proximal Point Method
claims.description: We develop a proximal point framework for the asymptotic analysis and numerical computation of rare-event probabilities in stochastic partial differential equations (SPDEs).

claims.name: Aashutosh Kulakarni
claims.title: Proximal Galerkin for Regularized Variational Fracture
claims.description: The equations of regularized variational fracture in brittle solids with the pointwise constraint of crack irreversibility will be solved using the proximal Galerkin method, as presented by Castillon, Khara, Dokken, Surowiec, Keith and Bazilevs.
